def restore(inp):
    H=len(inp)
    # find solid 3-rect
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(inp) if 3 in r]
    cols=[j for j in range(len(inp[0])) if any(inp[i][j]==3 for i in rows)]
    out=[row[:] for row in inp]
    for i in rows:
        for j in cols:
            out[i][j]=inp[H-1-i][j]
    return [out[i][cols[0]:cols[-1]+1] for i in rows], out
